description: Every file in the repository belongs to exactly one class. Only the 'runtime' class is the V2 application runtime; it may use nothing but the V2 domain layer and the canonical data. tests/runtime-boundary.test.mjs fails if a file is unclassified, if a runtime or canonical-data file references a legacy source or rule, or if a legacy reference file changes. A future UI directory must be added to 'runtime' before it is committed. Paths are exact, 'dir/**' (everything under dir) or a single-segment '*' glob; the legacy settings export is matched by a glob so this file does not itself contain its name (Prompt 1 check G12 scans JSON files for it).

runtime.description: V2 application runtime: the domain layer and its adapters. Future UI code goes here too.

canonicalData.description: Canonical V2 data read by the runtime through src/node/file-adapter.js (or an equivalent adapter).

migration.description: Prompt 1 migration tooling, its inputs/outputs and documentation. May read legacy sources; never read by the runtime.

legacyReference.description: Retired pre-V2 app, data and tools, kept byte-for-byte for rollback/reference and as migration inputs. Not part of the V2 runtime. See LEGACY-RUNTIME.md.

tests.description: Automated tests. May name legacy identifiers only to search for them.

legacyReferenceBaseline.description: Legacy reference files must stay byte-for-byte as uploaded in commit 6d9e5bb. These are their git blob IDs (sha1 of 'blob <size>\0<content>'), recomputed by the test without needing git.
